Google Messages for web is already open in this box's Chrome at https://messages.google.com/web/u/0/conversations (signed in). Send ONE SMS/RCS from this account.

Recipient: John Jensen (search if not in the visible sidebar). Do NOT message Jensen Parents, Beau Jensen group, or anyone else.

Message text EXACTLY:
Hello im a robot that work on behalf of tyson

Steps:
1. If a conversation with exactly John Jensen is visible, open it.
2. Otherwise click Start chat, search John Jensen, pick the person named John Jensen (not a group).
3. Type the message exactly as given.
4. Send it (Enter or Send).
5. Confirm it appears as a sent bubble in that thread.

If login/QR pairing is required, STOP and report that. Do not invent a phone number. Do not send to a group.

Report: whether it sent, the conversation title you used, and the exact text sent.

Not sent — the account is not actually paired for web messaging.

What I saw: navigating to https://messages.google.com/web/u/0/conversations redirects to the Google Messages welcome screen (signed in as Tyson Goulding, tyson.goulding@optconnect.com). Clicking "Continue as Tyson" lands on a Setup page: "Message from your phone number on your other devices" — instructions to open Google Messages on the phone and sign in to the Google Account there, plus a "Pair with QR code" option. No conversation sidebar, no John Jensen thread, no compose box is available.

Blocked: device pairing/QR scan on Tyson's phone is required — a human step I can't do. Nothing was typed or sent; intended text was: Hello im a robot that work on behalf of tyson
